Not recommended bets. Backtested on 3,333 games (2021–2025) this model hits 49.86% against the closing line; break-even is 52.38%.

Its measurable edge is closing-line value — +5.6 pp drift-adjusted — and that edge sits almost entirely in games priced inside two touchdowns. Past 21 points it fades to −2.4 pp (z = −0.90), so the biggest disagreements remain the least trustworthy. Week 4 is also near the weakest point of the season: roughly 3 games of evidence per team.

Lines are home-perspective, matching CFBD: −7.5 means the home side is favoured by 7.5. PROJ. LINE is the model's number on that same scale; MODEL PICKS names the side it prefers at the current market price. Projected scores are the model's expected points, not a score prediction — they will rarely look like real football scores.

Market numbers are the consensus across available books. Garbage-time plays are filtered by CFBD win probability; drive metrics exclude end-of-half kneel-downs and defensive scores. AP ranks are the poll standing entering week 4.
